source_proposal.lane_entry: A8 replacement family, second remediation round (selection re-frozen at v3): lane-1 families died by their own frozen rules (WKNDLIQ G12 veto-measured, SILRES rule-4 coverage); the v3 selection's top-2 cross-lane survivors are V17-a5-P1-ATTN-PHASE (already implemented) and V17-A6-P2-OICASCADE (novelty 0.1899, razor-thin vs panel_daily:ret margin 0.0101, RECORDED THIN per P-2, never yet implemented - this lane)

frozen_semantics.exposure: H4 event gate on the published UTC grid (H1 panel rows bucketed to UTC H4 - a sanctioned post-extraction derivation; decision at the H4 bucket close T): r_OI(T) = OI(T)/OI(T-24h) - 1 from the REDUCED open-interest endpoint series (data.binance.vision futures metrics sum_open_interest, 1,095-file sha-manifested pull, reduced cache at the per-arm endpoint_series path), gated at its trailing-120d P10 (neighbour P5) of the PRIOR 720 strictly-past H4 closes AND the panel 24h return R_24h(T) = last_price(T)/last_price(T-24h) - 1 < 0 at bucket closes; event(T) = 1 iff both conditions hold
frozen_semantics.availability_law: endpoint series value at H4 bucket i is the LAST metrics snapshot with create_time tau <= close(i) (snapshot-at-tau, never forward-filled beyond tau; the +/-30 min endpoint tolerance maps to bucket PRESENCE on the 5-min cadence - a bucket with a value has its own snapshot within tolerance, a null bucket means no admissible snapshot so the endpoints are stale beyond tolerance); r_OI uses the substitution frozen in the proposal ('else undefined = 0'); threshold quantiles use strictly-past H4 closes only ([T-120d, T-4h], the proposal's '720 H4 decisions of consumed lookback'); NO same-bucket close peeking (signal at H4 close T fills at the next H4 bucket's VWAP); no snapshot after a bucket close can influence its decision (the decision at i reads only endpoint buckets i and i-6 and the strictly-past quantile window)
frozen_semantics.entry_fill: LONG +1 unit notional per symbol independently at the event; entry.lag_buckets 0 + fill_price vwap => the fill executes at the position bucket's published VWAP, which by the one-bar lag IS the next H4 bucket after the decision (the frozen 'next-H4-bucket VWAP = sum quote_total / sum qty_total over its H1 rows')
frozen_semantics.exit: exit at the VWAP of the first H4 bucket whose close >= T + 24h => exit.holding_buckets 5 (family: entry bucket t+1, exit bucket t+6 = exactly the bucket whose close is T + 24h); the neighbour's 48h holding => arm override 11 (exit bucket t+12)
frozen_semantics.no_reentry: one position per symbol; events firing while a position is open are IGNORED (series 0.0 at the suppressed decision) and the book re-arms only after flat (no pyramiding); the taken-event set is pairwise >= 24h apart
frozen_semantics.force_flat: driver purge law (SILRES convention): any decision whose holding window touches a +/-1-full-UTC-day purged fold boundary, a fold edge, or the grid end is never booked; no fills and no carries inside purge zones; no position ever touches S1
frozen_semantics.control: randomized-event-time sham (event-mechanism control class, NOT calendar): numpy default_rng seed 1717 (fresh generator per symbol - the sham is per-symbol), rejection-sampling per symbol the SAME number of 24h LONG windows as the anchor book's taken windows, at H4 closes sampled uniformly over S0, excluding +/-1-day fold purge zones, any close within +/-3 days of a true gate-fired event of that symbol, and any close within 24h of an already-accepted sham window (redraw on collision; exhausted draw space is a hard fail-closed error); direction always +1; identical next-H4-VWAP fills, once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs and force-flat law. This severs the conditioning link (OI collapse + down-move) while preserving unconditional long exposure. G11 contract: sham earns the same (positive) sign with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp| => family DIES
frozen_semantics.threshold_convention: RECONCILIATION (recorded): the rolling quantile is numpy.percentile linear interpolation over the strictly-past 720-close window (the registry-standard convention pin shared with SILRES/ATTN-PHASE); the D2 novelty probe's nearest-rank variant was a measurement script, not the frozen trade gate - D2 is already recorded (0.1899 PASS) and not re-argued. The exposure_series_spec's '(T - 120d, T]' window wording belongs to the D2 conditioning-exposure spec; the trade gate implements the features_and_lags/warmup law 'threshold quantiles use strictly past H4 closes' / 'recomputed from past-only H4 closes at every event evaluation' with the warmup section's own count (720 consumed H4 decisions)
frozen_semantics.warmup_reconciliation: RECONCILIATION (recorded, QUESTION_FOR_A1): the proposal seeds the trailing-120d window from pre-S0 metrics 2025-04-25..2025-08-21 so that ALL of S0 is tradeable, but the sha-manifested pull (d2/oi_metrics_manifest.json, 1,095 files) covers S0 ONLY (2025-08-22..2026-08-21). On the cached authority the 720-close window funds no decisions before S0 H4 index 720 (2025-12-20T00 close), so fold F0 (S0 days 0..119) cannot book an anchor event on a 365-day window; the implementation is data-source-agnostic and fail-closed (short window = honest warmup None, never a partial quantile). A1 owns the repair decision: pull the pre-S0 warmup segment (raw zips re-fetchable per the manifest URLs) or re-scope the warmup
frozen_semantics.data_authority_notes: RECORDED for A1 (QUESTION_FOR_A1): the reduced cache (v17_data/oi_series_reduced.json, git-ignored, lives only in the integration worktree) carries BYTE-IDENTICAL arrays under all three symbols - the D2 reduction (d2/pull_endpoint_series.py pull_oi_metrics, final cache write) wrote the loop-final per-symbol series under every key, so the BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT entries hold SOLUSDT's values; the per-file manifest itself is intact. No scored OICASCADE cell should run until the reduction is re-run (no network re-download was permitted for this implementation lane); the formulas and tests are synthetic-only and data-source-agnostic
frozen_semantics.costs: taker fee EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (L-V14-0), TIER 2.0 PRIMARY BOOK (fee 5.0 bps x 2.0 = 10.0 bps per fill, slip floor 2 ticks) - frozen driver kernel; two taker fills per symbol per event round trip

sham_calendar.note: calendar_conditioned=false (selection v3 OICASCADE lane): the control is a randomized-EVENT-TIME sham (numpy default_rng seed 1717 per symbol, matched count of 24h long windows, +/-1-day purge-zone and +/-3-day true-event exclusions, redraw on collision) - an event-time sham class, NOT a calendar sham; sham_control_calendar rows carry this not-applicable marker per diag/sham_control_calendar@1 (persisted under the frozen calendar_conditioned predicate => the validator's LOW finding is accepted and disclosed, per the D2 re-freeze instruction)

control_reproduces.rule: falsification_rule (K1), verbatim: CONTROL REPRODUCES - the randomized-event-time sham earns the same (positive) sign with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp| at tier 2.0 pooled over S0 (G11) -> DEAD, unconditional drift/beta explains the anchor
control_reproduces.enforcement: fail-closed in run_v17_cell: pooled after-cost expectancy = net PnL per booked round trip, anchor vs control T2.0 books; an unevaluable (zero-trip) book refuses the cell

fold_negative_majority.rule: falsification_rule (K2), verbatim: ANCHOR NEGATIVE - anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0 in >= 2 of the 3 chronological folds (G1/G3 territory) -> REJECT
fold_negative_majority.enforcement: fail-closed in run_v17_cell: per-fold expectancy = per-fold net PnL / scored population; a zero-population fold is recorded null (unevaluable_folds) and counted neither negative nor positive - disclosed, never hidden

ancestry_veto_measured.rule: falsification_rule (K3), verbatim: ANCESTRY VETO - D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure series and ANY forbidden conditioning exposure (OI families in particular) -> vetoed as re-label; no clock, threshold, universe or sign-flip rescue is permitted
ancestry_veto_measured.enforcement: fail-closed in run_v17_cell: the D2 measurement is carried FROZEN (selection_freeze_v3_v17.json: G12 D2 already measured 0.1899 PASS, margin 0.0101 recorded thin per P-2; do not re-argue) and the driver mechanically checks the recorded value against the frozen threshold in every scored cell record
